notes.title: Taivas version 0.2 has released: fixes and new level
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38528600/eabc96f42b77e9a1cfb36e0d82c521a40460b178.png

Hi!

Taivas version 0.2 has released!

This version brings new level (continued to Cave level) and new end boss is waiting you in Level 1: Part 2!

Upade also brings these fixes f.e.:


 1 special ability (15 sec waiting time), purchase this special ability from the wizard on first level
 Zombies where quite hard to kill, with this update you can kill them more easily
 More health portions


Best regards

TAIVAS devs

notes.title: Taivas version 0.1 has released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38528600/9e4da5bafaceb94c83058dfc4445b08dc0584f42.png

Hello players

We have now released first version of the Taivas game!

On this version you will be able to first level of the game and it offers 30-45 minutes gameplay. Plan is to add many new levels during the development. Next update will bring at least one new level and improvements to the level 1. 

TAIVAS live broadcast

Live broadcast will be on live during this week. We'll announce exact time 1 day before the event.

Have fun!

TAIVAS dev
